name: Rain of Sparks
body:
You are adept at making sparking torches that spew forth unbelievable amounts of sparks.

Prerequisite(s): Pyro sparking torch special torch attack class feature, base attack bonus +5.

Benefit(s): Your sparking torch special torch attack ability inflicts 1d6 point of damage per two levels, instead of 1d4, and the radius increases to 10 ft.
